reviews.review:
Whatever it is, I hope AH will do their best to improve the Game.
I like it, no matter what´s "nerfed" and what´s "buffed". There are more than enough weaopons to get the sh*t done.
Using the same weapon for everything is just not working, the plasma shotgun for example is great for groups of enemies and terminig eggs, but useless or challanging to use for close and long range, it´s great.
The weapons in Helldivers might change and the flamethrower incident was clearly an exploit and everyone knew.
This is no reason to bash on the developers with bad reviews. 
Constructive Critisism.
"Hey, the flamethrower isn´t working as intended, the changes brought up some drastic problems such as richocheting flames from armored enemies and the new look doesn´t feel good"
The state the Community is in, is awful. I thought the goal was for a non toxic playerbase and yet I´m seeing hardcore metaplayers insulting others because of their way of playing. I´m using the smoke eagle to clear out automaton bases undetected and I know of better and faster methods. I´m just not using them now.


I´m not better than anyone else in this game, let´s just be good with the developers and state our issues with normal critisism. "It´s too easy, repetitive or too hard" this game litterally let´s you choose the difficulty and besides that, you can set yourself a challenge with another build.
Have fun with what you have until the next patch and the flamethrower is still good, just change the way you behaved before the patch.

I highly recommend this game to anyone who likes too shoot up bugs and bots with his/her friends. Lot´s of weapons, big maps with different objectives and a lot of stratagems to use in the field make it one of the best horde shooters ive ever played. Just focus on yourself and make your own opinion on it, not following what´s best and what´s worst will just kill your fun like in any other game. Here is no Competition it´s all about freedom and democracy
Very fun shooter. Great sense of humor. Every dive is thrilling. I gotta earn all the ship upgrades!

the most fun I've ever had playing a Third person shooter in my life, hands down. Unfortunately, It seems like half the playerbase is a mess of winging fools who expect to be able to kill every enemy in sight with their rifle. every update the same complaint of "dont nerf weapons its a PvE game!" Is all i hear for about two weeks until everyone finds a new weapon that does every job in the team at once and they abuse it until the devs fix it.

Helldivers is a team based game. if no one else on your team brought AT, *you're the one who needs to bring AT*. Stg half the people complaining grab their favorite weapons and ignore their teammates.

Only Legitimate issue with the game atm is the lack of variety. there are about 5-6 mission types for each faction, with 5 or so side objectives that dont change depending on the faction, and 5 more that do. Thats it. Most of the missions boil down to "get to point a, Press a button/Destroy a thing to go press a button/destroy a thing at point b" or "go blow up that thing(s)." it *does* get old, but grab some friends, play it for a bit and go play something else for a few weeks before coming back. there'll be a new warbond for you to grind for and fun new stuff to unlock. 

If you want The best 4 player PvE shooter since left for dead, this is it. I'll die on this hill.
